Miss Yonge would be obliged if [Messrs Macmillan](/organisation/111) would send copies of each of her works to
Sister Elizabeth
[St Mary’s](/organisation/21) Home
Wantage
Also one copy of [the Heir of Redclyffe](/book/15) for herself


[^1]: Endorsed ‘Rail/28 5/77’ and (against ‘herself’) ‘Post 28/5/77’.
